items.source: The annotated method must have a void return type for synchronous consumers, or can return Mono<Void> for asynchronous consumers. The method should accept a single parameter of type List<McpSchema.Prompt> that represents the updated list of prompts after the change notification.
items.translation: 注释方法对于同步消费者必须具有 void 返回类型，或者对于异步消费者可以返回 `Mono<Void>`。该方法应接受一个类型为 `List<McpSchema.Prompt>` 的单个参数，该参数表示变更通知后更新的提示列表。

items.source: Methods annotated with this annotation are used to listen for notifications when the list of available prompts changes on an MCP server. According to the MCP specification, servers that declare the listChanged capability will send notifications when their prompt list is modified.
items.translation: 使用此注解标注的方法用于监听 MCP 服务器上的可用提示列表变更时的通知。根据 MCP 规范，声明了 `listChanged` 能力的服务器会在其提示列表被修改时发送通知。

items.source:
Used as connection or client identifier to select the MCP client that the prompt
change listener is associated with.
items.translation: 用作连接或客户端标识符，以选择提示变更监听器所关联的 MCP 客户端。

items.source:
Used as connection or client identifier to select the MCP client that the prompt
change listener is associated with. At least one client identifier must be
specified.
items.translation: 用作连接或客户端标识符，以选择提示变更监听器关联的 MCP 客户端。必须至少指定一个客户端标识符。
• MCP 提示词列表变更通知

items.source: the client identifier, or empty string to listen to all clients
items.translation: 客户端标识符，或留空字符串以监听所有客户端。

items.source:
Annotation for methods that handle prompt list change notifications from MCP servers.
This annotation is applicable only for MCP clients.
items.translation:
用于处理来自 MCP 服务器的提示列表变更通知的方法注解。  
此注解仅适用于 MCP 客户端。

items.source:
@McpPromptListChanged(clients = "test-client")
public void onPromptListChanged(List<McpSchema.Prompt> updatedPrompts) {
    // Handle prompt list change notification with the updated prompts
    logger.info("Prompt list updated, now contains {} prompts", updatedPrompts.size());
    // Process the updated prompt list
}

@McpPromptListChanged(clients = "test-client")
public Mono<Void> onPromptListChangedAsync(List<McpSchema.Prompt> updatedPrompts) {
    // Handle prompt list change notification asynchronously
    return processUpdatedPrompts(updatedPrompts);
}
items.translation:
@McpPromptListChanged(clients = "test-client")
public void onPromptListChanged(List<McpSchema.Prompt> updatedPrompts) {
    // 处理提示词列表变更通知，包含已更新的提示词
    logger.info("提示词列表已更新，现在包含 {} 个提示词", updatedPrompts.size());
    // 处理已更新的提示词列表
}

@McpPromptListChanged(clients = "test-client")
public Mono<Void> onPromptListChangedAsync(List<McpSchema.Prompt> updatedPrompts) {
    // 异步处理提示词列表变更通知
    return processUpdatedPrompts(updatedPrompts);
}
